response.sql: WITH type_avg AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM type_avg) AS diff_from_mean_of_averages FROM type_avg

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with NULL spent or NULL/zero amount are excluded, since the ratio is undefined for them. Lines with amount = 0 are dropped to avoid division by zero.
Only budget lines that match an event are included (inner join). Event types that are NULL form their own group.
'How far' is the signed difference (type average minus the mean of the per-type averages), not the absolute value.

alternatives.interpretation: Report the distance as an absolute value, so the deviation has no sign.
